.gp-theme-frosted-glass {
  --gp-font-display: var(--gp-font-rounded);
  --gp-ink: #ffffff;
  --gp-ink-dim: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  --gp-ink-soft: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
  --gp-ink-faint: var(--text-muted);
  --gp-ink-badge: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  --gp-ink-shadow-lg: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  --gp-ink-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
  --gp-ink-overtime: #ff6b6b;
  --gp-ink-overtime-glow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.5);
  --gp-scrim-alpha: 0;
  --gp-shape-base: #ede5f3;
  --gp-shape-radius: var(--gp-radius-shape);
  --gp-shadow-rgb: 0, 0, 0;
}

.gp-theme-frosted-glass .gp-glass-orbs, .gp-theme-frosted-glass .gp-glass-pane, .gp-theme-frosted-glass .gp-glass-highlight {
  display: block;
}

  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  border-radius: inherit;
}

.gp-theme-frosted-glass .gp-orb {
  position: absolute;
  width: 110%;
  height: 110%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(24px) saturate(140%) brightness(0.9);
  opacity: 0.95;
  transition: background var(--gp-dur-ambient) ease-out;
}

.gp-theme-frosted-glass .gp-orb-1 {
  --gp-orb-warm: #f6d365;
  --gp-orb-cool: #a594c9;

}

}
